name: @cloudsforge/ui
description: The CloudsForge design system: tokens, chrome, brand marks and chart primitives.
//: THE ENTRY POINTS NAME dist/, AND dist/ IS COMMITTED. Every consumer resolves this package through `link:../ui/packages/ui`, which symlinks this working tree; nothing in that path ever runs a build here, so an entry point naming src/ meant thirteen frontends compiling this package's TSX with THEIR OWN toolchain settings. That is what produced the classic JSX transform under `node --test` and the `globalThis.React` workaround in eight of them. It also meant the artefact that would be published had never been executed by anything. src/ is still what is edited and still what the source maps point at; `src/dist.test.ts` rebuilds it on every `pnpm test` and fails if a byte differs, so a stale dist cannot be committed. See README, 'Why the build output is in git'.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/tokens.css src/ui.css dist/
